DeviceName.description: Name this device is given on D-Bus.

PlatformConfigName.description: A platform configuration names the device with this string, which is how a device described by a platform is paired with the configuration its board exposes for it.

PollRate.description: Poll the device at this rate, specified in milliseconds, to fetch sensors
